fact: 1948年日本处于盟军占领（GHQ/SCAP）第三年：1946-1947年已完成土地改革、劳动组合法、独占禁止法；1948年 GHQ 开始「逆转」（Reverse Course），从惩罚性改革转向经济重建优先。

sources.title: The role of government in the postwar growth process of Japan — Journal of Asian Economics
sources.quote: The most remarkable feature of Japan's postwar economic performance was the rapid surge of economic growth from a state of devastation and defeat in World War II.

fact: 1948年12月美国国务院与国防部向麦克阿瑟发出「经济稳定九原则」指令（NSC-13/2），要求日本平衡预算、加强税收、控制物价、稳定工资、固定汇率；这一指令后来成为1949年2月道奇来日的基础。

sources.title: The role of government in the postwar growth process of Japan — Journal of Asian Economics
sources.quote: At the practical level, they were enforced by Joseph Dodge who was sent as an economic adviser from Washington, D.C., in February 1949. The policy package adopted by Dodge was generally called the Dodge Plan.

fact: 1948年日本通胀率仍高：1946-1948年东京批发物价指数上涨约15倍；日元在1948年仍处于多重汇率制，官方汇率为360日元兑1美元（1949年道奇路线正式固定）。

sources.title: The role of government in the postwar growth process of Japan — Journal of Asian Economics
sources.quote: Obviously, this was a package which consisted of belt-tightening measures for orthodox stabilization purposes.

fact: 1948年东京仍维持配给：大米、煤炭、棉布均按券供应；黑市大米价格为官方配给价的10-30倍；城市居民在周末前往农村以衣物换取大米。

sources.title: The role of government in the postwar growth process of Japan — Journal of Asian Economics
sources.quote: Japan succeeded in catching up with the Western powers by the late 1960s, reaching the forefront of major industrialized countries in the 1980s.

fact: 1948年日本工业恢复以纺织、机械、煤炭为主；战前财阀（三井、三菱、住友）在1946-1948年被 GHQ 指令解散，但企业集团的成员关系在1950年代重新聚合为系列（keiretsu）。

sources.title: The role of government in the postwar growth process of Japan — Journal of Asian Economics
sources.quote: The occupational policies and reforms as the fundamental base of postwar economic growth.

fact: 1948年日本在 GHQ 指导下继续改革：1947年5月3日新宪法生效，1948年开始实施民法、刑法修正；妇女在1946年已获得选举权，1947年教育基本法实施。
